task: Structurally rework issue #2743 (Claude to Copilot skill-syntax translation). The user rejected the prior appended-appendix design as a complicated layer of indirection and directed a first-principles rework: question the requirement, ruthlessly cut, add back only what is strictly needed, optimize. Chosen approach (Path B): keep the Claude source syntax intact and inline-translate Skill()/Task() calls in the generator, with no source edits and no appended reference table. Skill(skill="X") becomes a backticked skill: tool-input span; Task(subagent_type="Y") becomes a namespaced agent_type: span; a prompt= argument appends a with prompt clause. Regenerate the 12 affected Copilot mirrors and bump both project-toolkit plugin manifests.
